narr: Thunderstorms which developed across northwestern Missouri moved south and east across central Missouri during the evening of the first and into the overnight hours. Storms began to train across the region producing rainfall amount from 2 to 4 inches with a few local readings as much as 6 inches. This rainfall produced flooding across the region along with isolated wind damage to trees and power lines.
ev: Highway B at Otten Branch and at several other low water areas was flooded and impassable.
Highway WW at Archer Creek was flooded with a portion of the road surface washed out due to flood waters.
A portion of Post Office Road at Spencer Creek was flooded and impassable.
lsr: Several reports of flash flooding along highway B south of Cole Camp.
